Assumption_or_Limitation: Selected IPL and T20I competitions from 2022 onward.
120 scheduled balls used as default; revised overs used where available. Shortened innings without reliable revised-overs data may be imperfectly represented.
Some D/L matches without reliable revised targets are excluded from chase pressure calculations.
Bowling economy is provisional because all extras have not been reconciled.
extras_2_runs interpretation is unresolved; it is not blindly added to official totals.
Bowler-credit wickets use selected dismissal types; all wickets are not credited to bowlers.
Pressure thresholds are heuristic: Low below 35, Medium 35–65, High 65 and above.
Weights are project-defined percentile-based scoring choices, not an official cricket-board formula.
IPL and T20I performances are combined; competition-specific differences may affect comparisons.
